headline: Baidu Fined $75,000 by Chinese Regulators Over Joyy Acquisition Failure
summary: China's State Administration for Market Regulation fined Baidu's Hong Kong unit 500,000 yuan ($75,000) for failing to receive required antitrust clearance before acquiring part of live-streaming business Joyy.
why: Baidu, Inc. is a major Chinese technology company specializing in internet services and artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: Baidu
impacts.why: Chinese market regulators penalized Baidu for unapproved merger execution under antitrust laws.
